independent_byte_checks: Accepted raw receipt SHA and current APK bytes/SHA matched each other and all phase guards.
All HANDOFF referenced bytes/SHA, phase command/result files, raw stdout/stderr SHA and rc were recalculated.
ZIP CRC and unique entry names, every DEX magic/length/SHA and all lib/*.so ELF headers were independently read from the exact APK.
DEX inventory names and target ARM64 readelf records matched the byte census.
limits: Host static inventory only; no app install, screen, runtime, or device acceptance.
Blackbox qualification and portfolio count are outside this review.
source_note: Accepted official raw is an older publisher download; current Play version equivalence is not established. One MIPS ELF is classified as other ABI, not ARM64.
